2.0.0.title: Argus 2.0.0 — The Ultimate Entertainment & Regional Powerhouse
2.0.0.intro: Argus 2.0 is our biggest milestone release yet, bringing unprecedented streaming performance, deep regional Indian cinema intelligence, zero-wait 4K seeking, live sports multi-commentary, and robust offline resilience.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Unlimited Wi-Fi Broadband Engine removes all bitrate caps, budget warnings, and throttling 24/7 on Wi-Fi.
Multi-Chunk Turbo Streamer allocates a 4GB demuxer cache and 3600s readahead for <200ms seek latency on 40GB–80GB 4K Remux / Dolby Vision files.
Vintage Cinema AI Shader Suite custom-tuned for Satyajit Ray, Uttam–Suchitra, and classic 35mm Tollywood / Indian cinema.
Multi-Commentary Instant Audio Switcher hot-swaps between Bangla (Akashvani Kolkata), Hindi (Sports Flashes), and English broadcast audio in 1 click.
Night-Owl Cinema Mode dynamically clamps loud explosions and commercial ad spikes while dimming subtitles to a soft warm amber.
Power-Cut & Load-Shedding Snapshot Vault journals session progress every 5 seconds for instant 1-click recovery after power cuts.
Embedded WebAssembly Retro Gaming Engine delivers 1-click emulation for GBA, SNES, PS1, and PSP classics directly inside Argus.
Hydra Addon Protocol & High-Speed Debrid Resolver supports Real-Debrid, Torbox, and AllDebrid for game repacks and cyberlockers.
Auto-Dub & Regional Audio Selector prioritizes 8 Indian regional dialects without manual track switching.
Tollywood & Bengali Detective Universe Rails surface Feluda, Byomkesh Bakshi, Ray classics, and modern thrillers.
Phonetic Transliteration Search resolves colloquial Romanized queries into native Bengali and Hindi titles.
Bluetooth Earbud Lipsync Profiler compensates for audio lag on boAt, Noise, Boult, and Realme TWS earphones.
Zero-Install QR Couch Handoff lets you transfer playback to any phone or tablet browser in 1 click.

sections.heading: Broadband, Network & Resilience
items: Automatic network connection profiling distinguishes uncapped broadband from metered mobile hotspots.
Smart daytime-leech & midnight-seed policy allows 24/7 uncapped seeding on Wi-Fi while throttling daytime mobile upload to 1 KB/s.
Night-Owl download scheduler queues heavy media for the 00:00 - 06:00 IST unmetered telco window.
Local LAN Peer-Share enables 1 Gbps file transfers across campus/home subnets with zero external data consumption.
Multi-CDN Stream Stitcher automatically switches to healthy edge mirrors if local ISP routing experiences packet loss.
Adaptive peak-hour buffer prefetching counters evening cell tower congestion (19:00 - 23:00 IST).

sections.heading: Visuals, Restoration & Shaders
items: Satyajit Ray 35mm Master shader recovers Subrata Mitra bounce-lighting and silver-gelatin monochrome contrast.
Golden Era Tollywood preset restores romantic classics and removes macroblocking from vintage DVD transfers.
Ghatak Realism preset delivers high-contrast expressionist shadows and crisp wide-angle grain resolution.
70s Eastmancolor Restoration recovers vibrant warm tones in classic desert and adventure titles.
Night-Owl dimmed subtitles eliminate dark-room glare with soft amber (#FFD7A0) 75% opacity styling.

sections.heading: Cricket & Sports Intelligence
items: Live audio commentary delay calibration syncs Akashvani Kolkata and Sports Flashes with broadcast video.
Smart Highlight Reel Synthesizer generates chapter markers for wickets, boundaries, and milestone celebrations.
Dugout Channel Mixer blends stadium crowd ambiance with regional radio commentary.
Ball-by-Ball Live Desktop Alerts notify you of key match moments even when minimized.
Indian OTT Streaming Rights badges display broadcast home (JioHotstar, SonyLIV, FanCode, Hoichoi, ZEE5).

sections.heading: Gaming & Hydra Addon Protocol
items: Debrid game downloader resolves repack magnets and direct download cyberlockers at maximum line speeds.
Automated Wine/Proton/GPTK prefix runner for macOS and Linux runs Windows games seamlessly.
Cross-platform game save path discovery and cloud synchronization.
Night-Owl large game download scheduler preserves daytime hotspot quotas.

sections.heading: Audio, Speech & Subtitles
items: On-device Whisper neural speech recognition provides real-time offline live subtitle transcription.
4-tier AutoSync pipeline aligns subtitles via community hash consensus, acoustic VAD, and affine drift regression.
Indian Serial Recap & Dramatic Filler Skipper bypasses 4-minute recaps and slow-motion staring sequences in daily soaps.
Audio-Only Frugal Mode (--vid=no) drops bandwidth to ~25 MB/hr for commentary and concerts.
10-band Dialogue Clarity EQ lifts center-channel speech while taming explosive bass and loud song interludes.
